criteria.description: Sorting must be applied after all filters (search, category, in-stock) have been applied — not before.
criteria.evidence: test 'sorts by price ascending' in tests/sorting.test.tsx PASSED (✓ 82ms). Confirmed structurally: src/utils/productFilters.ts lines 13-23 apply search/category/inStock filters first; sort operations on lines 25-31 come after all filter steps — no BUG comment present, ordering is correct.

criteria.description: Search filtering must be case-insensitive: typing `wireless` (all lowercase) must return the product 'Wireless Mouse'.
criteria.evidence: test 'filters products by search term' in tests/filtering.test.tsx PASSED (✓ 83ms). src/utils/productFilters.ts line 14 applies `.toLowerCase()` to both `filters.search` and `product.name` before comparing.

criteria.description: Search filtering must trim leading and trailing whitespace from the input value before comparing.
criteria.evidence: test 'filters products by search term' in tests/filtering.test.tsx PASSED (✓ 83ms). src/utils/productFilters.ts line 14 explicitly calls `filters.search.trim().toLowerCase()` before the `.includes()` comparison.

criteria.description: Search filtering must match only against `product.name`, not any other field.
criteria.evidence: test 'filters products by search term' in tests/filtering.test.tsx PASSED (✓ 83ms, showing 1 product for 'mouse'). src/utils/productFilters.ts line 14 filters on `product.name` exclusively — no other field is referenced in the filter expression.

criteria.description: Category filter with value `All` must return all products; a specific category value must return only products whose `category` field strictly equals that value.
criteria.evidence: test 'filters products by category' in tests/filtering.test.tsx PASSED (✓ 29ms). src/utils/productFilters.ts line 18 uses strict equality `product.category === filters.category` guarded by `filters.category !== 'All'`.

criteria.description: In-stock filter when enabled must exclude every product where `inStock === false`.
criteria.evidence: test 'filters products by in-stock only' in tests/filtering.test.tsx PASSED (✓ 26ms). src/utils/productFilters.ts lines 21-23 filter `product.inStock` when `filters.inStockOnly` is true.

criteria.description: All active filters (search, category, in-stock) must combine additively — enabling one must not override or discard the others.
criteria.evidence: All three filter tests in tests/filtering.test.tsx PASSED (search ✓ 83ms, category ✓ 29ms, in-stock ✓ 26ms). src/utils/productFilters.ts applies each filter sequentially on the same `result` array (lines 13-23), each narrowing results without resetting others.

criteria.description: Sorting must not mutate the original product dataset — subsequent unfiltered renders must still show the original order.
criteria.evidence: All three tests in tests/sorting.test.tsx PASSED (price-asc ✓ 82ms, price-desc ✓ 34ms, rating-desc ✓ 30ms). src/utils/productFilters.ts line 11 creates a copy with `[...products]` (spread) before any `.sort()` mutation.

criteria.description: 'Clear filters' button must reset ALL filter fields — `search`, `category`, `inStockOnly`, AND `sortBy` — to their initial/default values (`''`, `'All'`, `false`, `'default'`).
criteria.evidence: test 'resets filters back to default values' in tests/clearFilters.test.tsx PASSED (✓ 127ms). Asserts search input='', category select='All', in-stock unchecked, sort select='default', results-count='Showing 15 products'.
